summary: PRODUCTION validation on https://car-repair-sys.emergent.host. Backend is fully functional via direct API (login, vehicles CRUD, visits, template resolve for invoice/diagnosis/quote all return unified-*-a4-mobile-v1 with selection_reason=tenant_default, outbound resolve-message, logout, unauth 401). HOWEVER a P0 blocker was discovered: the deployed frontend bundle (/static/js/main.8b85fd39.js) is hard-coded to call https://alkobir.com/api/* instead of the production host, so ALL browser calls (login, refresh, everything) fail with CORS ('No Access-Control-Allow-Origin' from alkobir.com for origin https://car-repair-sys.emergent.host). UI login is completely broken end-to-end. As a result, UI-based document generation, stamp before/after approval, PDF download, print view, and full E2E metrics could NOT be captured. Test data was created and fully cleaned up via API. No documents/journal entries were persisted.

minor.issue: Body-based refresh ({refresh_token:...}) returns 401 'No refresh token' — only cookie-based refresh supported. Not necessarily a bug (matches iter299 design) but should be documented.

get_or_create_customer reuses an existing customer by phone even when customerName differs (created with name 'TEST - DO NOT USE', phone '0500000000' → reused existing empty-name customer id 0077b4b4...). Silent identity merge — potentially data quality risk.

ui_bugs.issue: P0 — BACKEND_URL is baked in as https://alkobir.com; browser calls to https://alkobir.com/api/auth/login and /api/auth/refresh are blocked by CORS from origin https://car-repair-sys.emergent.host. UI login fails 100% of the time. Users cannot access the app via the production URL.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by the above — could not execute UI login → vehicle page → QuickPrint → PDF/print/stamps flow.

security_findings.note: Only Cloudflare edge headers observed (server: cloudflare). None of the standard hardening headers are set by the app/edge. P2 hardening.
security_findings.unauthenticated_protected_endpoints: GET /api/vehicles and GET /api/auth/me correctly return 401 without token.
security_findings.secrets_in_bundle: Grep for sk-/SECRET_KEY/JWT_SECRET/SUPABASE_KEY/BYPASS_TOKEN found no real secrets (only CSS class name substrings like sk-image, sk-linear). Clean.
security_findings.wrong_backend_domain_in_bundle: https://alkobir.com is embedded in main.8b85fd39.js as the API base — this is the root cause of the P0 UI login failure. Frontend must be rebuilt with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://car-repair-sys.emergent.host and redeployed, OR alkobir.com backend must add https://car-repair-sys.emergent.host to its CORS allow-list AND the two backends must share the same MongoDB/Supabase state (unlikely — this looks like a stale/misconfigured build).

Backend is confirmed healthy on prod — do not repeat backend regression unless config changed. Cleanup pattern: DELETE /api/visits/{id} then DELETE /api/vehicles/{id}; verify with GET → 404.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (P0): The production frontend was built with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL pointing to https://alkobir.com (visible via `curl https://car-repair-sys.emergent.host/static/js/main.8b85fd39.js | grep -oE 'https://[a-z.-]+' | sort -u`). Browser requests are therefore sent cross-origin to alkobir.com, which does not include https://car-repair-sys.emergent.host in its Access-Control-Allow-Origin header, so every fetch (login, refresh, everything) is blocked at the CORS preflight stage. Main agent's curl checks succeeded because curl bypasses CORS AND targeted the correct host directly. Reproduction: open https://car-repair-sys.emergent.host/login in a browser → DevTools Network tab → attempt login → observe 'Failed to fetch' with CORS error against https://alkobir.com/api/auth/login. Mitigation: rebuild frontend with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://car-repair-sys.emergent.host (or the intended internal origin) and redeploy; confirm the new bundle contains no reference to alkobir.com.
